decision_rule: Corrected = a fact in the line is unsupported by a current stated row, outdated by a coordinator ruling or a newer stated row, misdated (incl. UKG 'Posted on' re-post stamps, ruling: say 'listed') or miscounted; a closing question without 'you' is corrected separately (kind other, form-only); a line that leads with an older fact while newer stated facts drive the score is corrected as form-only ordering. Bottleneck guesses are inferred; corrected only when they state as fact something no row supports or place another site's fact at the plant. Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be reached. Every number, date, count or status used in a line was re-read on 2026-11-17: job boards via their APIs or raw pages, and every news, company and government row behind a line fact via a fragment-wise quote check (quote split on '...', each fragment found on the live page; 35 rows, all found).
